narrative.overview: Completely new image-first light editorial identity, explicitly authorized by the user. Software engineer first: web interfaces, mobile apps and backend systems. All testing/observability tools remain secondary.
keyCharacteristics: Porcelain, graphite and one burnt-orange accent
Licensed Manrope lettering in three weights
Six open skill groups, no cards or project descriptions

rules.name: Software engineer first
rules.body: Keep web/mobile/backend and building software central. No testing-first headlines or employment metrics.

dos: Keep the one-picture README compact and provide all skill names in alt text.
Keep real project/contact links below the poster.
donts: Do not restore the previous lime/dark/ribbon world.
Do not add fake controls, proficiency bars or invented claims.
